hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Review accumulated rewards and track progress toward holiday bill reduction without gamification pressure.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer visits the rewards overview to inspect cash-equivalent worth and active goal progress.
hypotheses.storyTension: Ensuring transparent, predictable value without intrusive promotional clutter or gamified distractions.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear display of statement credit utility and direct access to automatic bill reduction options.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of accumulated cash value and progress toward bill-reducing rewards.
prohibitedDetours: Gamification elements like leaderboards or public rankings
Voucher or travel partner discovery pushes
completionSignals: Customer views point balance and cash equivalent accurately
Goal progress toward holiday spending money is clearly displayed
Frictionless access to statement credit redemption options

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Verify guaranteed reward rates and confirm automatic payment allocations for predictable financial planning.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer checks cashback earned alongside balance to verify guaranteed reward rates.
hypotheses.storyTension: Need for absolute clarity on cash-equivalent worth without complex financial jargon.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Transparent presentation of cash-equivalent values and automatic statement credit rules.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Confidence in predictable, guaranteed reward rates applied directly to bills.
completionSignals: Confirmation of automatic statement credit allocation
